Publication statement: [Baltimore, Md.] : A. Schwanecker, Water St. 57, [1835]
Shows the counties of St. Mary, Charles, and a part of Prince George, on the Western Shore of Maryland.

Shows the counties of St. Mary, Charles, and a part of Prince George, on the Western Shore of Maryland. Relief shown by form lines. "Proportion of vertical scale = 10 feet." In lower left corner: A. Schwanecker, Water St. 57. Issued with 5 other maps. Accompanied by: Report of the engineer & geologist, in relation to the new map, to the executive of Maryland. 1836. 89 p. diagr. chart. LC copy imperfect: upper margin deteriorated. LC copy mounted on cloth. Accompanied by positive and negative photostats. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
